newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI appoints two new directors.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI appoints two new directors.

text.p: Engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that Tony Daniels and Russell Chenu will be appointed diectors of the company.

"It is proposed that Mr. Daniels will succeed me as chairman consequent upon my retirement," chairman Ted Harris said in a statement. The effective date of Daniels' appointment will be March 3, 1997, Harris said.
Daniels was the former managing director of engineering group Tubemakers, which is now a unit of The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd
Chenu joined ANI in September 1995 as chief financial officer.
His appointment as finance director is effective February 17, 1997.
